measured.paintOrder: equal-priority overlap paints the highlight later in registry iteration order (highlightNames); priority 1 paints above 0; delete then set moves a name last
measured.liveRanges: Range.setEnd and Text.insertData repaint the highlighted cells; a StaticRange paints its offsets
measured.teardown: document replacement and rv_host_destroy clear the document registry and empty every highlight registered in it; an unregistered highlight keeps its ranges; every handle stays usable until released
measured.registryClear: registry.clear() unregisters names one by one and leaves each highlight its ranges, as Chromium does (WebKit HighlightRegistry::clear empties them)
measured.order: a range added again and a name set again keep their positions; the constructor adds a repeated range once; values() and entries() are snapshot copies

assertionCount: custom_highlights counts 378 on every run. Before f079f62 the Ahem font wait counted assertions on each iteration (385 on native40-candidate-3); no case was removed.

highlight.iterationLive.reason: The ABI has no live iterator: Highlight.values() returns a snapshot copy, so a set mutated during iteration leaves the snapshot unchanged (highlight.iterationSnapshot and highlight.afterIteration equal Chromium).

paint.redReplaced.reason: As paint.redSetAgain: replacing the highlight of the registered name 'red' keeps its map position; Chromium paints it on top, native keeps the registry iteration order (green on top).

paint.redSetAgain.reason: Chromium paints a re-set name as the most recently registered while keeping its map position, so Chromium's paint order disagrees with its own iteration order (keys stay [red, green]). Native paints equal-priority highlights in registry iteration order, so the later-registered green stays on top.

registry.iterationLive.reason: The ABI has no live iterator: HighlightRegistry.entries() returns a snapshot copy, so a map mutated during iteration leaves the snapshot unchanged (registry.iterationSnapshot and registry.afterIteration equal Chromium).
